methods.accuracy: Strict recorded single-option accuracy; available reference retained; invalid final predictions are errors.
methods.confidence_intervals: 95% Wilson for accuracy; 10,000 paired-question percentile bootstrap samples for differences; seed 20261011; CIs are not simultaneous/multiplicity-adjusted.
methods.test: Two-sided exact McNemar: binomial test on discordant paired questions, identical previous function.

multiplicity.panel_vs_baselines: All90=6panels x 3baselines x 5sets. Own60=3heterogeneous x3members x5sets +3homogeneous x1member x5sets. Within-panel15 and own-panel families are transparent sensitivity analyses, not interchangeable significance claims.
multiplicity.organizer: 15=3heterogeneous pairs x5sets; includes fresh-run variation, not an isolated causal organizer effect.
multiplicity.independent_controls: Separate15-test families for independent majority and oracle, heterogeneous panels only. Majority ties follow each panel's organizer.

methods.homogeneous_controls: Use saved distinct in-panel first-round calls, analysed in rounds_first_round_controls.csv. Never duplicate a single baseline to invent a three-call oracle.
methods.overlap: No grand accuracy or independence-based pooled tests across overlapping sets; MARC100 is nested in MARC250.
methods.historical_context: Preserve original18-test results and train1000 results separately; no new full-dev run exists for five variants.
methods.safety: Only result CSVs/metrics and previous analysis files read; no experimental notebook/API/SQLite execution.
